name: The Boys: Finale
overview: In the epic series finale, the long-standing and brutal conflict between Billy Butcher and Homelander finally reaches its absolute breaking point. As Homelander prepares to make a world-altering live announcement on Easter Sunday to reshape the nation under his rule, the surviving members of The Boys must band together for one last, desperate assault on the White House to stop the Supes once and for all. With the stakes higher than ever, sacrifices must be made as the world of Vought collapses into chaos.
